{"id":1176711755,"question_id":72,"lang":"csharp","lang_name":"C#","time":"2 years, 5 months","timestamp":1708065493,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"58 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1176711755/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Edit Distance","memory":"45.2 MB","code":"public class Solution {\n    public int MinDistance(string word1, string word2) {\n        int n = word1.Length;\n        int m = word2.Length;\n\n        int[,] dp  = new int[n+1,m+1];\n\n        for(int i = 0; i <= n; i++)\n        {\n            dp[i,0] = i;\n        }\n        for(int i = 0; i <= m; i++)\n        {\n            dp[0,i] = i;\n        }\n\n        for(int i = 1; i <= n; i++)\n        {\n            for(int j = 1; j <= m; j++)\n            {\n                if(word1[i-1] == word2[j-1])\n                {\n                    dp[i,j] = dp[i-1,j-1];\n                }\n                else\n                {\n                    dp[i,j] = 1 + Math.Min(dp[i-1,j-1], Math.Min(dp[i-1,j], dp[i,j-1]));\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        return dp[n,m];\n    }\n}","compare_result":"","title_slug":"edit-distance","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":345}
